name: Web3Privacy Now
summary: The Web3Privacy Now link page, published with Simple Page (open source, GPL-3.0). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens its own code reports the visit to Plausible and reads from a Tenderly RPC endpoint, simplepg.org and euc.li.

connections.note: Visit reported by the page's own code when it opens.

connections.note: Read when the page opens, without proof.
